title: Remus joins the church and Valentine plays there
summary: Remus quits music to join church, Valentine plays trumpet in his church twice, then quits John Casme's band.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
